heading_path: Global Revolution 2024 – Collaborator invitation – conference bursaries

content_blocks.text: The conference organisers are delighted to once again offer a limited number of bursaries which may be used to cover speaker expenses at the conference.
heading_path: Global Revolution 2024 – Collaborator invitation – conference bursaries

content_blocks.text: The bursaries are funded by the PPRG and the Procurement Lawyers Association (PLA), respectively.
heading_path: Global Revolution 2024 – Collaborator invitation – conference bursaries

content_blocks.text: PPRG bursaries are available for early career academics from the Global South
heading_path: Global Revolution 2024 – Collaborator invitation – conference bursaries

content_blocks.text: PLA bursaries are available to legal practitioners, including those from developing countries to attend as speakers or panel contributors, or potentially as delegates (subject to justification).
heading_path: Global Revolution 2024 – Collaborator invitation – conference bursaries

content_blocks.text: Bursaries are usually of a value of between £500 and £1,000 depending on the level of funds available (which we will know closer to the time) and the (travel) needs of the successful applicant. Bursary funds will be paid only against receipts.
heading_path: Global Revolution 2024 – Collaborator invitation – conference bursaries

content_blocks.text: To apply for a bursary, please send in a brief explanation (of no more than 300 words) setting out why you think you are keen to attend the conference and why you would benefit from a bursary. The deadline for applications is December 15 th 2023 . Applications should be sent by post to Conferences, University of Nottingham, University Park, Nottingham NG7 2RD
